items.title: Initiative window in dark theme
items.do: With Foundry's Interface theme on Dark, start a combat with Aveline, Durgan, Orc Warrior, and Goblin Sneak and open the Initiative window.
items.expect: The Initiative window body, side headers (Heroes / Enemies), rows, attribute buttons, and steppers all render in dark theme with crisp, readable text and no cream/pastel bleed-through.

items.title: Consolidated 2d12 Tools drawer in Token Controls
items.do: Look at Foundry's Token Controls bar with Aveline or Sylwen selected, then click the single 2d12 Tools button to toggle Line of Effect, Weapon Range & Reach, Show Flanking, and Light Levels Overlay, and launch Cover Height, Area Height, World Clock, and (as GM) Encounter Log / Damage Report / Create Chat Button.
items.expect: Token Controls only shows ONE 2d12 button (no toolbar clutter); clicking it opens the floating 2d12 Tools drawer grouped into Map Overlays (with live ON/OFF pills and active count badge), 3D & Rules Tools, and GM Tools.

items.title: 3D Area Height Calculator ignores dead tokens
items.do: Mark an Orc Warrior or Goblin Sneak Dead (or defeated in combat) on a scene with live Aveline and Durgan, then open Area Height (3D) from the 2d12 Tools drawer.
items.expect: Only living tokens appear in the Area Height top-down grid, side cross-section, and creature list; dead/defeated tokens are excluded.

items.title: Compact Pick dialogs sizing & Encounter End order
items.do: End an encounter with Aveline and Durgan (to open "The encounter ends") and try Shove with Aveline holding a two-handed weapon (to open "Shove: no free hand").
items.expect: Choice buttons expand cleanly around their title, subtitle, and right tag with zero text overflow or overlap; in "The encounter ends", Party Momentum and "How did the encounter end for the party?" appear ABOVE Overcome / Retreat / Neither.
